title: Correct fringe width formula
description: Essential Criteria: Student must apply the fringe width formula Δx = λL/d for each wavelength.

title: Third-order fringe positions
description: Important Criteria: Student must correctly compute positions as x₁ = 3Δx₁ and x₂ = 3Δx₂ for the third-order fringes.

title: Distance between fringes
description: Essential Criteria: Student must subtract the two positions to find the final distance, yielding 6.0×10⁻⁵ m.

title: Unit consistency
description: Important Criteria: Student must convert all quantities to consistent SI units (mm to m, nm to m) before calculation.

title: Sign error in subtraction
description: Pitfall Criteria: Student incorrectly subtracts Δx₁ - Δx₂ instead of Δx₂ - Δx₁, giving a negative or incorrect magnitude.

title: Order misinterpretation
description: Pitfall Criteria: Student uses n=3 incorrectly (e.g., multiplies by n after finding fringe separation instead of before).

title: Alternative geometric reasoning
description: Optional Criteria: Student clearly explains that the separation grows linearly with order n.
